findings.summary: Tenant config endpoints trust spoofable TenantContext for write scope
findings.details: TenantFilter populates TenantContext from X-Client-Subdomain header. Service used TenantContext.getClientId() for all mutations — cross-tenant write was possible.
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — all TenantContext.getClientId() calls replaced with tenantValidator.getCurrentClientId() (JWT-derived)
findings.recommendation: Derive clientId from authenticated principal, not TenantContext.

findings.summary: Xoxoday sync can deactivate all active non-cash catalog items on empty provider response
findings.details: XoxodayApiClientStub returned List.of() and was registered in all profiles.
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — @Profile({'local','localtest','test'}) on stub; threshold guard in runSync()
findings.recommendation: Do not register empty stub outside test/local profiles; make sync fail-closed on suspicious responses.
